Although the device family exceeded the hub cap and the IP address utilized an anonymous or transparent proxy (`id_23`), the risk profile was heavily elevated by suspicious online activity. Furthermore, the customer explicitly denied making the transaction, solidifying the fraudulent determination. Similar historical precedent shows that customer verification plays a decisive role in resolving such disputes when model decile scores present mixed signals. Per the policy engine actions, the card has been blocked and a formal case created.
